summary: Iteration 12 tested avatar upload (multipart + public /avatar-image), Kanban tasks CRUD + cascade delete + persistence, UI scaling slider (0.8-1.3), and login regression. Backend pytest 9/9 passed. Frontend end-to-end verified with Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1763 lines; overdue for modular split (auth, users, projects/tasks, integrations, admin, activity).

POST /api/tasks/{id}/... update_task does not check ownership/project membership - any authenticated user can update or delete any task by task_id. Recommend adding an owner_id or project membership check.

POST /api/users/me/avatar has no file-size limit and no MIME type validation; a malicious user could upload arbitrary content masquerading as image. Consider size cap (e.g., 5MB) and image sniffing (e.g., PIL open) before persisting.
GET /api/users/{user_id}/avatar-image is public with no rate limiting - acceptable for now but flag if scale increases.

delete_project deletes tasks only when the caller is the project owner (delete_one with owner_id filter). If a non-owner calls it, tasks are still nuked via delete_many (no owner scope) - move the delete_many inside the success branch of delete_one to avoid orphan-task deletion by non-owners.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_Kanban, TEST_Cascade, TEST_UIKanban projects and associated TEST_ tasks. Uploaded a 1x1 PNG avatar for demo user (persists - not cleaned as no delete-avatar endpoint exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_avatar_kanban.py cover: seed logins (4), avatar upload+public fetch+404, kanban CRUD, project delete cascade, and settings PUT regression. Frontend Playwright covered: scale slider (0.8-1.3 via scale-up/down buttons updates --ui-scale and root font-size to 20.8px @1.3, persists via localStorage stitches_scale), avatar upload via hidden file input (use state='attached' since input has class='hidden'), full Kanban flow (create project -> board -> add task in todo -> task-move-btn moves to doing -> reload persists -> delete). Testids all match spec.

verification_details.avatar: POST /api/users/me/avatar returned {avatar:<url>} with /api/users/{uid}/avatar-image path. Public GET returned 200 image/png with body. /auth/me reflects new avatar. avatar-preview src shown in Settings and 2 img tags on page (sidebar + settings) use the same URL. Persists after reload.
verification_details.kanban: 3 columns render (todo/doing/done). Task created via add-task-todo + task-input + task-add-submit appears in To Do. task-move-btn moves task to next column (verified todo->doing). Reload persists all task state. task-delete-btn removes card. Backend confirms tasks list sorted by created_at asc, and DELETE /api/projects cascades tasks to zero.
verification_details.ui_scaling: Initial --ui-scale=1, rootFontSize=16px. scale-up x6 -> 1.3, rootFontSize=20.8px (matches calc(16*1.3)). scale-down x12 -> 0.8. Slider input event also updates value. localStorage stitches_scale is written.
verification_details.regression: All 4 seed accounts login successfully. Projects create/list works. PUT /api/users/me returns 200.

rca of the issue: N/A - no defects observed in this iteration.
